description: Frozen test oracle for the Infosys Q1 FY25 consolidated P&L. Every parser, store, and render test in the Fundamentals product checks against this manifest. Values are cross-validated across two independent first-party extraction paths (NSE Ind AS XBRL, context-aware; issuer results PDF, PyMuPDF word-geometry) with zero numeric conflict, and pass all four cross-foot identities. See docs/research/infy-q1-cross-source-comparison.md.

sources.sha256_note: NSE Ind AS consolidated XBRL, re-pinned in Slice 1 (finding 8) by re-fetching via NseIndiaApi from https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/xbrl/INDAS_109110_1192961_18072024074507.xml on 2026-08-21. The source bytes are held gitignored (not committed); the synthetic tests/fundamentals/fixtures/synthetic_q1_fy25_*.xml reproduce its structure without redistributing NSE's bytes.
sources.context_note: Consolidated current-quarter durations bind to context OneD (2024-04-01 -> 2024-06-30, segment-free); instants bind to OneI (30-Jun-2024). This quarterly file carries only current-quarter contexts (no prior-period columns), so the period-context trap does not arise here; the segment-dimension trap does (see distractors).
Consolidated P&L printed on page 11; first data column is the quarter ended 30-Jun-2024.

distractors.reason: Standalone scope must NOT be selected when the consolidated basis is requested; the ~10% lower profit is the classic error.
distractors.label: Profit for the period (standalone)
distractors.note: The standalone XBRL file uses the SAME 'OneD' context id as the consolidated file, so context_ref alone is insufficient to discriminate scope - the parser must key on scope + entity + source file. NSE's results_comparison summary endpoint surfaces this 5,768 standalone value (libs-pipeline-capability.md 1.1), a live example of the trap.

distractors.reason: Standalone EPS must NOT be selected when the consolidated basis is requested.
distractors.label: Basic EPS (standalone)
distractors.note: Consolidated EPS is 15.38; standalone is 13.90 - a ~10% error if the basis is confused.

distractors.reason: The same element name appears under segment-dimensioned contexts (OneReportableSegmentRevenue01D..08D); a naive .find()/first-value read can return a segment value. Bind to the segment-free OneD.
distractors.label: Revenue from operations (segment-dimensioned)
distractors.note: Segment members carry a partial revenue value under the same RevenueFromOperations element; the canonical fact is the segment-free OneD total 39,315. This is the segment-dimension trap that DOES arise in the Q1 file.

distractors.reason: ProfitOrLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent (6,368) is a DIFFERENT concept QName from ProfitLossForPeriod (6,374); it must not be relabelled as the profit-for-period fact.
distractors.label: Profit attributable to owners of parent
distractors.note: Per roadmap 11, the old 6,358/6,822 'oracle' was this attributable-to-owners vs ProfitLossForPeriod concept mismatch, NOT a Q1 context issue.

cross_foot_identities.identity: Total income = Revenue from operations + Other income
Profit for the period = PBT - net tax expense
Profit for the period = attributable to owners of parent + non-controlling interests
cross_foot_identities.source_note: Attributable-to-owners 6,368 and non-controlling interests 6 both confirmed all-agree across the NSE Ind AS XBRL and the issuer results PDF (docs/research/infy-q1-cross-source-comparison.md, rows 'attributable to owners' and 'non-controlling interests'). 6368 + 6 = 6374.

notes: Q1's year-to-date period EQUALS the quarter (Apr-Jun 2024 is both the first quarter and the first-quarter YTD), so the quarter-vs-YTD context-selection trap CANNOT be exercised on Q1. A separate Q3 FY25 fixture (Slice 1) tests quarter-vs-YTD-vs-prior-year selection: ProfitLossForPeriod quarter-duration (Oct-Dec 2024) = 6,822 vs the nine-month YTD, and disambiguates it from the attributable-to-owners 6,358.

Both on-hand first-party sources trace to the SAME issuer filing (NSE XBRL and the issuer PDF) via independent extraction methods - cross-method, not cross-host. BSE 'in-bse-fin' Q1 XBRL is not on hand, so there is no independent-host confirmation yet.
SEC 20-F is FY25 ANNUAL in USD and must never be footed against this Q1 INR quarter; it is excluded from the Q1 evidence package.
